_doc: The fallen and what a blow throws (specification 003 T008, Prender-262): a blow of force 5 on a street corner where people walk (60, 8; at the centre, force 3 reached nobody and force 20 buried the one body under the towers it felled) with the clock running, the bodies of the dead lying where they fell and those knocked down, and the pieces thrown in their tints (effects.json tints: wood, metal, leaves, flesh); four seconds after it, near (30 px a metre) from 60 degrees at four azimuths, and from above (80); by day.
